inspection_method: All 12 delivered images were individually opened with tools.view_image at 768px; corrected variants were reopened after rerender.

images.observations: Deep empty basin and stepped metal rim read clearly. Faucet hangs over the bowl. Both projecting door pulls are readable; framing is unclipped.
Basin, faucet clearance and U pulls remain open. Cabinet silhouette and sage/cream distinction remain clear; rounding is visibly coarser.
Oak worktop, four drawer/door fronts and side shelf distinguish the island. Corrected towel-rail hooks meet the side posts; hanging cloth and dish stack are legible.
Storage bays and rail remain open and supported. Main identity is preserved. Thin oak surface seams disappear, an accepted decorative simplification.
Open hutch shelves and two plate stands are clear. Corrected bowl rests on its shelf. The upper-right mug is partly occluded by the common camera view; no framing crop.
Tall hutch silhouette, open shelves and lower cupboard remain recognizable. Plate/bowl stepping is coarser; upper-right mug remains partly occluded.
Three visible caster wheels imply the four-wheel cart; native data contains all four. Slatted shelves, towel stack, drawer and raised transport handle are clear.
Casters, two shelf bays and drawer pull stay readable. Small oak inlays simplify, while open storage and transport-handle clearance remain visible.
Three separated plates, curved divider loops, hollow utensil cup and tray handle are visible. Added lower crossbar supports plates without filling slots.
Three plates remain separated. Cup cavity, rack spaces and tray handle opening remain readable; plate contours step at the expected lower resolution.
Three different-height knife handles and metal blades read clearly above the slanted oak block. Unused front slot is visibly hollow; inserted blades now reach hidden slot floors.
Knife silhouettes remain separate and the unused front slot stays open. The sloped block intentionally shows larger native voxel steps.

contact_sheet_observations: Actual six half previews assembled into a labeled 3x2 sheet. Title and all labels are legible; no image or label clipping.
